title: Prop catalogue manifest 0.2.0
description: One assets/<catalogue>/manifest.json. Version 0.2.0 adds curated placement semantics to every row. The semantics block says those fields are estimated by a person, not observed in the file. A manifest without schema_version 0.2.0 is read as before and is not checked here.

description.description: What the object is, how it looks and its state, in one sentence for the placement model.

placement.description: Where it belongs. kit_only: a building or road kit piece that overgrow never places. interior: a prop for inside a room, which overgrow never places either. wall_mounted: on a facade (anchor facade). street: may stand in the carriageway. kerb: sidewalk edge by the road. wall_foot: on the ground against a wall. boundary: along a lot or block edge. open_ground: yards, lots, plazas, parks. ground_cover: flat on the ground.

grouping.description: How copies sit together. run: end to end in a line (span may repeat it). grid: along and up a wall (cover may repeat it). cluster: a few loose copies. single: one copy.

yaw_deg.description: Optional. Counter-clockwise turn about the vertical, in degrees, that the library applies when it loads the GLB, so the long side of a file authored along Y lies on +X as placement expects. The GLB is not rewritten.

refused.description: Optional. The library never loads this row and reports the value as the reject reason. unknown_scale: the file has no reliable size in metres. low_detail: a flat-colour model that reads as untextured beside the textured library (headset, 10 November 2026).
